scope: Modern and Classic My music category previews only

assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: one standalone square music-category preview image, full bleed. The reference is an Android My music screenshot: use only the subject and palette of the specified category tile as visual inspiration, not the whole screenshot. Make a slightly modified original variation with a fresh camera angle/composition while retaining its recognizable theme. Polished early-2010s music-player imagery, restrained contrast, subtly cinematic lighting. Keep the bottom 20 percent naturally dark and quiet for separate HTML labels. Category: Songs, the first tile in the reference. Show luminous blue and cyan audio equalizer bars formed from small rectangular light cells against deep black, viewed nearly front-on with a very slight perspective. Vary the bar heights and arrangement from the reference. Crisp recognizable equalizer geometry, subtle glow, saturated blue highlights without purple or rainbow colors. Digital music visualization rendered as a premium bitmap.
